recent_decisions.summary: No maxEdges override needed: demo graphs are small and the dev-only runtime warning surfaces if a consumer feeds a denser graph. Scale drill exceeds the cap by design and is already documented inline.

Fix lives in the canvas layer, not the demo, because the cause is a generic mismatch between the two animate sources; every routeEdges consumer that sets layoutOptions.animate:false while leaving the canvas prop truthy benefited without touching demos. The layoutSettledRef guard fixes a distinct secondary flash (initial fresh-fcose mount routing on pre-layout positions) with a per-instance flag reset at cy creation and flipped at first layoutstop.

Adopted untracked src/demo/legibility/fixtures.ts (parallel-session drop) as canonical: 14-degree hub, 6+2 bus, single-exposed-radio holon. Reused hubBurst/busCollapse from brief 06 (commit 4526192) and HolonicAdapter.projectHolonBoundary from brief 12. Pseudo-node style rules are field-scoped (node[?pseudo], edge[type = ...]) per canvas doctrine so real elements never see a data-mapper. Camera captured on viewport + restored on re-init so raw<->spread does not refit wildly (raw and spread differ in node-id set, which is by contract a different graph).

recent_decisions.subj: edge-bundling shipped as pure geometry in @g3t/core
recent_decisions.summary: FDEB (Holten van Wijk 2009). Deterministic: no RNG, fixed subdivision/iteration schedule; compatibility matrix computed once (O(E^2)) across all cycles. Endpoints re-pinned from input positions so no drift can appear at route[0]/route[last]. maxEdges bypass returns straight polylines with skipped=true. bundledPolylineToSegments projects onto Cytoscape curve-style: segments so the existing routed-edge class renders it.

Cytoscape ships cy.png natively so no new dependency; blob output + URL.createObjectURL/revoke pattern already used elsewhere; selection-scoped raster is not meaningful so opts expose only full/scale/bg. SVG export deferred (needs cytoscape-svg + bundle-ledger entry).

recent_decisions.subj: rdf12 hyperarc click-to-inspect + holon interior drill (a hyperarc is a graph itself)
recent_decisions.summary: Wired the already-shipped DetailInspector + useSelectionStore (CytoscapeCanvas auto-taps into the store) plus a new pure buildStatementInterior(full,stmtId) that copies the statement node and its outgoing rdf:subject/rdf:object/annotation edges into a self-contained sub-UGM. Demo-local, zero core API change; swapping to a different node-id set is a legitimate canvas re-init per camera-stability doctrine. Jake's framing 'a hyper arc can be a graph itself' is realized literally: entering a diamond shows its interior as a graph, nested diamonds drill deeper.
